arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo, replace

# R7: replace function and method
new_ver = replace('1.2.3', major=2)
print(f'Replace major 2: {new_ver}')
assert new_ver == '2.0.0', f'R7 replace function failed: {new_ver}'

vi = VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3-alpha+build')
print(f'Original vi: {vi}, prerelease={vi.prerelease}, build={vi.build}')
new_vi = vi.replace(major=2, minor=3)
print(f'Replace major=2, minor=3: {new_vi}')
# The method keeps prerelease and build from original
assert str(new_vi) == '2.3.0-alpha+build', f'R7 replace method failed: {new_vi}'

# Test replace minor only
new_vi2 = vi.replace(minor=5)
print(f'Replace minor 5: {new_vi2}')
assert str(new_vi2) == '1.5.0-alpha+build', f'R7 replace minor failed: {new_vi2}'

# Test replace patch only  
new_vi3 = vi.replace(patch=7)
print(f'Replace patch 7: {new_vi3}')
assert str(new_vi3) == '1.2.7-alpha+build', f'R7 replace patch failed: {new_vi3}'

print('R7 PASSED')
"
